Mamata Banerjee addresses TMC exodus, Abhishek Banerjee's office faces demolition

West Bengal Chief Minister Mamata Banerjee has addressed a continuing exodus of leaders from the Trinamool Congress (TMC), stating those under pressure are free to leave. This comes as TMC MP Abhishek Banerjee's party office in Amtala was demolished due to alleged building violations. Meanwhile, Abhishek Banerjee has challenged rebels to return, stating he would resign if they did not.
